column1: # Local LLM model catalogue (DEV-e). Read by `llm models` / `llm model`. Columns (tab separated):
#   id  file  url  sha256  size(bytes)  role  note
# url is pinned to the Hugging Face commit; sha256 and size are the LFS values of that commit (checked against
# https://huggingface.co/api/models/<repo>/tree/<commit>, field lfs.oid). `llm models fetch` verifies the hash before it
# renames the download, so a changed or truncated file is never used. role: default | quality | candidate | fallback | tiny
# (`fetch --all-candidates` takes everything except tiny). Files live in ~/.local/share/llm/models/. All Apache-2.0, not gated.

column7: Qwen3.5 2B: multilingual (ru/uk/en), small KV cache, fast on Vulkan
Qwen3.5 4B: better translation and commit messages, about half the speed
Gemma 4 E2B: usually the strongest small model for Ukrainian, large file (bake-off only)
Qwen3 4B Instruct 2507: plain transformer, the fallback if a Qwen3.5 hybrid op runs on the CPU
Qwen3.5 0.8B: battery case or if the 2B misses the latency target (never fetched by default)
